stem: In a circle with a radius of 6 centimeters, an arc has a length of 15 centimeters. What is the measure, in radians, of the central angle that intercepts this arc?
solution: Arc length \(s = r\theta\), with \(\theta\) in radians.
verify:
t=symbols('t')
ans=solve(Eq(6*t,15),t)[0]
assert ans==Rational(5,2)
assert all(Rational(s)==ans for s in spr_answers)
